Name: Ridgeside Village Jio and Philip anime portraits
Author: AstaEckhart
Description:
English is not my mother tongue, please forgive me.

◆ How to use
◇ Jio and Philip portraits（Portraiture）:
1. You need to download two mods, Portraiture and [url=https://ridgeside.fandom.com/]Ridgeside Village[/url].
2. Put my files into the Portraiture folder.
3. Finish!

◇ Jio and Philip portraits（HD Portraits）:
1. You need to download two mods, HD Portraits and [url=https://ridgeside.fandom.com/]Ridgeside Village[/url].
2. Put the file into the Mods folder.
3. Finish!

*You only need to choose one of Portraiture and HD Portraits!

◇Jio Sprites: Just overwrite the original file, remember to back it up!

▼ Path ▼
Mods\Ridgeside Village\[CP] Ridgeside Village\Assets \Characters
Mods\Ridgeside Village\[CP] Ridgeside Village\Assets\BeachCharacters

*If you have installed other avatar mods for the same character, please check for conflicts.
-

◆ 如何使用

◇ 吉奧與菲利普的肖像（Portraiture）：
１．你需要下載兩個模組，Portraiture和 [url=https://ridgeside.fandom.com/]Ridgeside Village[/url]。
２．將我的圖片覆蓋在Portraiture的資料夾裡。
３．完成！

◇札恩的肖像（HD Portraits版）：
１．你需要下載兩個模組，HD Portraits和 Ridgeside Village。
２．將文件置入Mods文件夾。
３．完成！

*Portraiture和HD Portraits你只要選擇一個即可！

◇ 吉奧角色：只需將我的圖片覆蓋在原文件中即可！

▼路徑 ▼
Mods\Ridgeside Village\[CP] Ridgeside Village\Assets\Characters
Mods\Ridgeside Village\[CP] Ridgeside Village\Assets\BeachCharacters

*如果你安裝了其他角色的肖像模組，注意檢查他們是否有衝突。
